sections.title: My line
sections.instructions: Anything that changes my ride on the Harbor Line: closures, new timetables, night service. A delay over ten minutes this week is an alert. If nothing changed, one quiet card that says so.

sections.title: Ocean science
sections.instructions: New results about the ocean with numbers behind them: papers, field trials, open data. Rank by how much they change what is possible, not by hype. Leave the section out on a day with nothing that clears the bar.
